text:
Maya R.: heads up — two customers hit opaque 413s when their mixed-dim arrays hit the fastpath splitter. support couldn't advise next steps.
Jessica L.: can we return structured error bodies? minimal example: HTTP/1.1 413 with body `{ code: \"embed_oversize\", reason: \"mixed_dims_or_bytes\", hint: \"call /v1/embeddings/preflight or set X-Embed-AutoSplit: true\" }`
Arun P.: runtime note — splitter will offer a slowpath fallback but if client fast-fails we short-circuit with 413. options: change default fallback behavior or teach SDKs to call preflight automatically on that error.
Ryan H.: SDK route seems low-risk. plan: detect 413 + `embed_oversize`, call POST /v1/embeddings/preflight, apply returned split plan, retry. will add `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true` opt-in header so we don't surprise users. also emit `embed_retry_after_split` metric. I'll prototype py/ts today.
Sam K.: console idea: small "Fix 413s" widget on route page when 413s spike. show suggested split size, sample curl, and a one-click preflight modal.
deploy-bot: rollout started: `embed-splitter:v2` -> us-west-2 (20%).
Jessica L.: spec items: structured `error.hint_type` values: `preflight`, `dimension_hint`, `bytes_hint`. include `expected_dims` array when splitter knows them. document in changelog.
Arun P.: add header `x-embed-splitter-reason: mixed-dims;preferred_split=1536` for proxies/observability. runtime already exposes preferred_split in traces.
Ryan H.: client example: POST /v1/embeddings with `X-Embed-Client-Hint: dims=4096,batch=20`. on 413 -> call /v1/embeddings/preflight -> get plan -> resend chunks. SDK will default off; opt-in header to enable auto-split.
Maya R.: owners & timeline — Ryan: SDK PR + tests by EOD. Jessica+Arun: spec + docs. Sam: console mock by Friday. I'll open a short support runbook with example queries.
Sam K.: Grafana queries needed: `sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status=\"413\"}[5m])) by (route)` and `ratio( sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status=\"413\"}[5m])), sum(rate(embed_requests_total[5m])) )` with drilldown to `embed.preflight.offered`.
Ryan H.: i'll emit tag `embed.fastpath.reject_reason` (values: `mixed_dims`, `bytes`, `unparsable`) and metric `embed.preflight.offered`.
Jessica L.: add preflight example in docs. sample preflight response: `{ plan: [ { start: 0, end: 10, dims: 1536 }, { start: 10, end: 20, dims: 512 } ], estimated_tokens: 12345 }`.
Maya R.: sync tomorrow 11am to close PRs and wire dashboard. tagging docs/support. thanks! :thumbsup:
